name: harness-browser
description: Human-paced browser action layer (BRW-01, ADR 0005): executes bounded navigate/scroll/type/click action plans against an injected driver with fixed, configured pacing for gentleness — deliberately never randomized or fingerprint-shaped, since pacing here is politeness, not evasion. Every navigation passes the site-access policy; every action lands in a replayable run log.
